scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "wrangler dev" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
